sections.title: What it is
sections.body: A one-die roll when the GM leaves an outcome entirely to chance.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use when the PCs are not directly causing the result but chance should decide a detail.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use when the PCs are not directly causing the result but chance should decide a detail.
Name the stakes first, then roll one Duality Die and interpret it openly.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.

sections.title: Try it
sections.body: Can we just see what chance says?
